title: Receiving Tolerance Units and Inbound-Shortage Case History (FBN)
content:
*Reimbursement desk guidance, Fulfilled by Northloop (FBN) inbound shortages.*

The tolerance units of a receiving tolerance are waived (0 units) for a seller who opened no other inbound-shortage case inside the case-history span of 6 months and whose enrollment has been active at least the tolerance tenure of 24 whole months, and are the repeat-shortage tolerance units of 3 units for a seller who opened at least the repeat-case count of 2 other inbound-shortage cases inside that span. Any other seller's tolerance units are not altered by this guidance.

Cases count toward the case-history span when fewer than the span's number of whole months — 6 — have passed from their opening moment to the handling date, a whole month passing on the same day number of a later month. "Other" cases are the seller's inbound-shortage cases besides the one whose claim is being worked out.

## Points of judgement

| Other inbound-shortage cases opened in the last 6 whole months | Enrollment active 24 whole months or more | Tolerance units |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | yes | 0 units |
| 0 | no | not altered |
| 1 | either | not altered |
| 2 | either | 3 units |
| 4 | either | 3 units |

Illustration (hypothetical): a seller with inbound-shortage cases opened 2, 5 and 7 whole months ago, besides the present one, has 2 other cases inside the span; the tolerance units are 3.
